current_detections.name: Liquidity Sweep
current_detections.evidence: Price spiked sharply above 64000 with high volume then immediately reversed downward, sweeping liquidity above recent range highs before collapsing back toward 61000.
current_detections.missing_conditions: None; sweep and reversal are visually complete.

current_detections.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
current_detections.evidence: Prior bullish market structure (higher lows into the spike) has been rejected; price is now making lower highs and testing downside support after the 64000 reversal.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Decisive close below prior swing low near 61000 to confirm bearish CHoCH.

current_detections.name: Bearish Flag
current_detections.evidence: Strong impulsive upward move to ~64200 followed by downward-sloping consolidation/flag formation as price drifts back toward 61000.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Clear parallel channel boundaries and breakdown below flag support to confirm continuation.
